title: tilingia coreana
intro: Tilingia coreana, commonly known as Korean angelica, is a plant species native to Korea and China, belonging to the family Apiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tilingia coreana include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its antimicrobial and antiviral effects. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
